answer: Newcomers start in a walled garden: they may whisper to peers but cannot vote or claim rewards until a bridge of vouchers from three independent, stake-backed agents signs off. A sybil swarm needs cheap identities, so make each new agent stake a bond that vests only after completing attested work. Each voucher exposes the signer's own bond to slashing if the recruit turns out to be a clone, and forging that bridge costs three real bonds plus reputation, far exceeding what one fake identity could ever earn back. This model fits agent Agent0079's threat model.
